name: nsight-graphics-analyzer
description: Drive NVIDIA Nsight Graphics 2026.1+ from Codex or Claude Code. Capture GPU frames, auto-export TSV bundles, and answer drill-down queries with small JSON artifacts so an agent can analyze GPU performance without loading multi-hundred-MB raw traces. Windows + NVIDIA GPU only.

interface.shortDescription: Capture and analyze Nsight GPU traces with JSON drill-downs.
interface.longDescription: Wraps NVIDIA Nsight Graphics 2026.1+ command-line tools for Windows GPU performance work. The skill captures Graphics Capture or GPU Trace sessions, auto-exports large TSV bundles, summarizes them into small JSON artifacts, and provides drill-down commands for stages, actions, metrics, and common bottleneck diagnoses.
defaultPrompt: Use $nsight-graphics-analyzer to profile a slow GPU frame.
Capture a GPU trace and explain the frame-time bottleneck.
Analyze this .ngfx-gputrace and show the hottest stages.
